title: Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent
abstract: arXiv:2610.21283v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world evolves under the planned rules; optional user actions steer it, while text requests can edit properties or extend capabilities with unaffected state preserved. Object texture memory retains reusable appearance only for whitebox-defined objects and adapts it as those objects change. The program advances world state, while a generative renderer combines current structure with remembered appearance. By organizing construction, intervention, and memo

translated_title: Mallea：利用编码代理构建、操控和记忆世界
translated_abstract: 代码世界模型通过显式状态和可执行规则来表示世界动态。我们研究了如何在这一框架内协调对象表示、行为修订和视觉记忆。我们提出了Mallea，一个能够从文本构建、操控和记忆世界的系统。编码代理从提示中推断对象交互需求，并联合规划对象结构、属性和规则，优先选择能够支持这些需求的紧凑表示。世界在规划好的规则下演化；用户可通过可选操作对其进行引导，而文本请求可以编辑属性或扩展能力，同时保持未受影响的状态。对象纹理记忆仅为白盒定义的对象保留可复用的外观，并随这些对象的变化进行适配。程序负责推进世界状态，而生成式渲染器则将当前结构与记忆的外观相结合。通过组织构建、干预和记忆（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: Mallea是一个基于编码代理的系统，能从文本构建、操控和记忆世界：代理联合规划对象结构、属性与规则，程序推进世界状态，生成式渲染器结合对象纹理记忆将结构与外观融合呈现。
en_tdlr: Mallea is a coding-agent-based system that builds, steers, and memorizes worlds from text, jointly planning object structures, properties, and rules while combining program-driven state advancement with a generative renderer that leverages object texture memory.
